scope: Read-only debugging explicitly authorized by root; selected binary method behavior inspected privately. Hashes and derived conclusions only: no upstream Code bytes/instruction sequences or ARR implementation copied into repository; no Java

derivedPolicy.neighbourPolicy: Any wanted cube in the27-neighbour volume prevents an already materialized unwanted cube from eviction; processEvictions refreshes its unwanted stamp and requeues.
derivedPolicy.dirtyBehavior: evictCube saves dirty cube before continuing; dirty itself is not an unconditional keep branch here.
derivedPolicy.actualEviction: After admission, dematerializes actual section, removes per-cube data and sets current status EMPTY.
derivedPolicy.columnLookup: columnFor delegates to columnAt; ready visible chunk lookup, not a generation join.
derivedPolicy.ownMixinScope: Generation schedule/advance time budget and tick-return observation; no eviction/retention override.

limits: No new per-target live eviction/dirty/lock event trace was run. Halo predicate is sufficient to explain the recorded retention; extra transient reasons are not excluded.
Current source and neighbour status plus real block reads were captured in actual native run; raw storage is preserved, not rewritten or injected.
